key.name: intensity
key.description: Low values look most natural. Screens with low contrast, or with blacks or whites cut off by their settings, may need higher values.

key.name: dark-balance
key.description: Relative to light surfaces. 1 makes the relief equally strong on both.

key.name: grain
key.description: Pixel-fine fibres and grain on top of the texture, relative to its intensity. Breaks up the rounded tooth, which on its own looks like leather.

key.name: true-size
key.description: Uses the size the monitor reports, so paper grain is equally large on every screen. Monitors without a size keep one texel per logical pixel.

key.name: mottle
key.description: Ink soaks into the paper unevenly and lightens dark areas in soft patches that follow the paper's formation. Dark areas don't get lighter overall.

key.name: brightness
key.description: Dims the whole screen while the extension runs.

key.name: paper-black
key.description: Gives the screen the blacks of print: even the darkest ink reflects some light, so shadows lift while midtones and white stay. White gets slightly warmer. 1 is the black of uncoated paper. Renders the screen offscreen first, at about the cost of the paper texture.

key.name: print-colors
key.description: Limits colours to what offset print on uncoated paper can reach. 1 is the full print gamut. Renders the screen offscreen first, at about the cost of the paper texture.

key.name: ink-spread-enabled
key.summary: Let ink spread into the paper

key.name: ink-spread
key.description: Dark strokes grow a little where the paper takes ink, with ragged edges, and creep along fibres in short feathers, like ink on absorbent paper. On some OLED panels whose subpixels are not laid out in plain RGB stripes, the ragged edges can look worse. Looks best at a display scale of 125 % or more, where strokes are wider than the edge. Reads neighbouring pixels, so big changes on screen cost more GPU time. Shares the offscreen rendering with the matte look and print colours.

key.name: light-scatter
key.description: Light that enters the paper next to ink scatters under it and is absorbed, so dark strokes get a faint soft halo and light gaps between them get a little darker. 1 is a scattering length of 0.25 mm, the most absorbent uncoated paper; sized from the size the monitor reports. Reads the same neighbouring pixels as ink spread, so big changes on screen cost more GPU time, but little more with ink spread on.

key.name: shift-texture
key.summary: Move the texture at login and unlock
key.description: A new random position each time spreads the wear of the texture's light and dark spots on OLED screens. Not in the preferences.

key.name: hide-in-fullscreen
key.summary: Hide the overlay on monitors showing a fullscreen window
